source_inventory.coverage_notes: The complete English NCP News archive and all linked article pages are monitored; English defines the public scope. The Arabic mirror is attempted and deduplicated where available. This covers published public announcements, not the broader investor pipeline.
source_inventory.extraction_method: Paginated official English/Arabic SharePoint public News archives and linked articles

source_inventory.coverage_notes: The public NHC scope covers investment categories and public qualification/application paths. The Arabic investment-opportunities page is the required category surface; its English equivalent is a supporting locale mirror. No current itemized Al-Ahsa investment inventory is exposed. Authenticated land/e-services are excluded.
source_inventory.extraction_method: Public NHC investment, qualification, and stimulation pages; no authenticated e-services

source_inventory.coverage_notes: Monitoring covers the publicly accessible Explore Opportunities landing page, all five discoverable ecosystem routes, the public company-opportunities route, linked public routes, and current content those routes expose without authentication. PIF-controlled search-index/historical content indicates a broader item population has existed, but no deterministic current public inventory or company roster is exposed.
source_inventory.extraction_method: Public PIF ecosystem and portfolio-company opportunity pages; item-level company/location validation

source_inventory.extraction_method: Public opportunity listing, linked project details, and public investor opportunity cards

source_inventory.coverage_notes: تغطية عامة محدودة: صفحة opportunities.html تعرض حاليًا حالة عدم توفر فرص عامة؛ invest.html يعرض مجالات عامة ومسار تسجيل يتيح تدفق الفرص بعد التسجيل/الدخول. صفحة map.html تعرض قريبًا، وواجهة المواقع العامة تعيد 58 مضلعًا (49 قطعة أرض و9 مواقع مشروعات) مع الاسم والإحداثيات والمساحة والحالة؛ الحالة الخام هي 48 شاغرًا و9 مستثمرة وواحدة فارغة. لا تحتوي الميزات على معرّف فرصة أو رابط تفاصيل، ولا تنشر شروط طرح أو تقديم. ملف Waha_clean.json القديم يعرض 84 ميزة متعارضة، لذا لا يُستخدم كجرد حالي. تُوثق الـ58 موقعًا كمرجع مكاني فقط ولا تُدرج كفرص استثمارية.
source_inventory.extraction_method: Official public pages and publicly referenced investment-location GeoJSON; catalogue-only, no opportunity adapter
